violations.msg: B.Cu ground is slit for ~50 mm at u~52 (v 11.5-61) by /USB_DP + /USB_DM (+3V3 beside them, v 13.5-34) running from J1 down to U6 CH340C. U3 SY8089's GND (via 54.01,43.59 board-uv) is right of the slit, in a B.Cu pocket closed by the +3V3 track (u 52.7 -> 57.37) and on F.Cu island of its own; its input caps C10/C11 ground through vias at u 47.5 (left of the slit). The 1.5 MHz input hot loop therefore closes around the slit's end near v 61: tens of mm instead of ~5. Same for C4 (TPS54302 input, via 50.77,22.51). Consequence: radiating di/dt loop beside the codec/LDO, ringing on +5V/+3V3, ground bounce in the codec half. Fix: put the USB pair on F.Cu (or move U6 next to J1) so B.Cu GND is unbroken under both bucks, and give C10/C11/U3 GND one copper island.

TVS D1 (SMBJ20A) is ~17 mm from J1 and reaches VBUS only through ~20 mm of 0.2 mm track and three 0.3 mm vias (J1 -> B.Cu -> via 59.84,12.53 -> through the CH224A area -> C1 -> via -> C4/C3/C5 -> D1). It never touches the VBUS pour at Q1's source or J1's pads. Consequence: hot-plug overshoot and surges at J1, Q1 and CH224A pin 8 are not clamped (track inductance/resistance in series), and a real surge (SMBJ20A Ipp 18.6 A) would fuse the 0.2 mm track before the TVS clamps. Fix: place D1 at J1/the VBUS pour (u 60-67, v 2-10) with pour-width copper to VBUS and a direct GND via.

Codec and class-D grounds meet only at the J1 neck (v<11.5) or around v>61, because of the B.Cu slit at u~52, the B.Cu PVDD pour between U8 and J1 (u 63.5-98.7, v 19.8-35) and the B.Cu AMP_IN diagonals and PVDD_SENSE track around C58. U8's 4-5 A supply return to J1 funnels through the ~8-11 mm channel u 52.7-63.5, while /AMP_IN_L/R are referenced to U7's ground and the INN AC-grounds C61/C63 to U8's. The channel's drop (est. ~2-3 mOhm x 4.6 A pk = ~10 mV) sits in the amp's input loop at 26 dB: est. ~0.2 V at the speaker, supply-current-correlated distortion and a possible low-frequency feedback path. Fix: make the input pseudo-differential (run each INN cap's ground end as a trace back to U7's ground beside its AMP_IN), and/or remove the slits so the two grounds share wide copper away from the amp return.

/AMP_IN_L (v 34.3) and /AMP_IN_R (v 37.5) run 22 mm on F.Cu between the 5 V buck (L5/C7, ~1 mm away) and the 3.3 V buck (L6 1.7 mm, U3 3 mm), over a B.Cu cut into strips by 7 perpendicular B.Cu tracks (B.Cu GND island u 41-46.7), then 24 mm diagonally on B.Cu under C58. TPS54302 (400 kHz) and TPA3118 (400 kHz) beat into the audio band if buck ripple couples into the input. Fix: reroute the amp inputs away from both bucks over solid ground (e.g. below v 50), with the INN reference alongside.

The 5 A VBUS entry is necked: J1's A4/B9 pad feeds Q1's source pour through a 0.6 mm x 1.4 mm stub and a 1.0 mm x 3.1 mm track (~80 % of the current); the B4/A9 pad goes through a single 0.6/0.3 mm via and 14 mm of 1.2 mm B.Cu. constraints.json declares VBUS 0.4 A and PVDD 0.8 A, so check_current/check_pdn never evaluated the 4.5 A the product's limiter allows (90 W at 20 V). The rest of the PVDD path (5 drain vias, 3.5 mm B.Cu column, 535 mm2 pour, 2 x 5 vias to the PVCC islands) is adequate. Fix: widen the J1->Q1 link to pour width (or extend the VBUS pour to J1's pads), add vias on the B4/A9 side, and declare the real current in constraints so the checks see it.

/OUT_L_P, /OUT_L_N, /OUT_R_P, /OUT_R_N are 0.31 mm over their full 12-17 mm, not just at the 0.65 mm-pitch pins. Sized for 1.0 A rms (9 dB crest); a sine or clipped/compressed DJ material at full power is 2.3-3.3 A rms (est. 60-140 C rise for a 0.31 mm 1 oz track). Fix: neck down only at the pin, widen to >= 1 mm (or a short pour) from the bootstrap caps to the inductor pads; there is room between C64-C67.

ESP32 antenna keep-out (u 0-7.2, v 55.5-80.5) only covers the antenna footprint: GND pour on both layers continues along the left edge to 2.2 mm from both antenna ends, and the plated M3 hole H4 (and its metal screw/standoff) is ~8 mm below the antenna. Espressif asks for the antenna to overhang the board or for ~15 mm of clearance. Consequence: detuned antenna, reduced Wi-Fi/BT range. Fix: cut the board back (notch) on both sides of the antenna or widen the keep-out along the edge, and check the enclosure wall there is plastic.

U8 thermal pad has 16 x 0.3 mm vias in the pad, mask open on both sides (not tented/plugged), under one 3.81 x 3.71 mm paste aperture (100 %). Solder wicks through to the bottom during reflow: voids under the PowerPAD (worse than the thermal waiver assumes) and solder bumps on B.Cu. Fix: tent the vias on B.Cu (or order plugged vias) and split the EP paste into windowpanes (~50-70 %).

SW1-SW3 are TS-1187A top-actuated 1.5 mm tact switches and D2 is a top-emitting 0603 LED, while the README records that the board sits ~31 mm under the lid (the reason U9 became front-facing). They need ~30 mm plungers/light pipe through the lid, or right-angle (side-actuated) switches and a right-angle LED facing the front wall like U9.

J4 has no L+ / L- / R+ / R- silk, so whoever wires the rear-panel binding posts has nothing to check polarity or channel against. Also the J3 reference text sits between J2 and J3, at J2's right peg, so it reads as labelling J2.

J4 (DB128V, 14 mm tall) wire-entry side could not be confirmed from the footprint or 3D model, and check_mating does not cover terminal blocks. If the mouths face into the board, the wires to the binding posts loop over C68-C71/L1-L4. Check the Dorabo drawing: the mouths should face the rear edge (v = 0).

architecture/blocks.md is stale against the board: it still has CH224Q, SMBJ24A, J4-J7 banana sockets, IRM-H638T, IR on GPIO39, the antenna at the 'top edge' and 2 x 220 uF bulk. The board and README have CH224A, SMBJ20A, the DB128V terminal, IRM-3638T on GPIO14, the antenna at the left edge and 470 + 220 uF.
